Pooja Shetty
pooja.shetty.dev@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx18 | github.com/poojashetty | Udupi
SUMMARY
Web developer experienced with PHP/Laravel and jQuery-based frontends. Comfortable with REST APIs and
relational databases but has not used React, Node.js, or MongoDB.
EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Science, Manipal Institute of Technology (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.2/10
SKILLS
PHP, Laravel, MySQL, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, REST APIs, Git, basic JavaScript
EXPERIENCE
Web Developer Intern, LocalCraft Studio (Dec 2025-Jan 2026)
•
Built and maintained Laravel-based admin dashboards for a small e-commerce client
•
Integrated payment gateway REST APIs and built jQuery-based dynamic forms
PROJECTS
College Club Management Portal
•
Laravel + MySQL application for managing club memberships and event registrations
•
jQuery/Bootstrap frontend with AJAX-based form submissions
CERTIFICATIONS
PHP with Laravel Framework (Udemy)
